text: They fined late parents. Lateness got worse.
Picture a daycare. Closing time is four p.m.
Some parents run late, so a teacher waits with their kid.
Ten daycares in Haifa. Six got a new rule.
Ten minutes late? You pay a fine.
Late pickups went up. Almost doubled.
The fine turned a favor into a price.
Paying for it took away the guilt.
